lines: Water drips somewhere behind the wall, slow and even.
A pipe knocks twice in the dark, then goes quiet.
Metal settles overhead with a long, tired groan.
Far off, a door slams and the sound rolls down the hall.
Footsteps pass in the room next door, then stop.
A vent fan stutters, catches, and runs again.
Ladder rungs ring faintly as the floor shifts underneath.
Distant machinery thrums through the concrete under your boots.
A tin can rolls across the floor somewhere above.
The radar screen crackles with a burst of static.
Dust sifts down from the ceiling in a thin grey stream.
Something heavy drags along a corridor far below.
A loose panel rattles in the draft from the shaft.
The music box plays three notes, then stops mid-tune.
Faraway, the carousel creaks around one more time.
A locker door swings shut on its own with a clang.
Water hisses inside a broken pipe, then falls silent.
The floor groans as weight shifts on the far side.
A hinge squeals in a room nobody has opened yet.
A dead light fixture buzzes above the doorway, weakly.
The battery gauge on the wall ticks down one notch.
A relay clicks on somewhere, then clicks off again.
A low hum rises from the walls and fades away.
Plaster cracks softly along the corridor ceiling.
The vent grille rattles as cold air pushes through.
Loose gravel shifts under a boot in the next tunnel.
A chain swings against metal, slow and uneven.
Overhead pipes tick as they cool in the dark.
Glass taps against glass in a cabinet nearby.
A cold draft slides under the door and along the floor.
Paper rustles in a drawer that nobody has opened.
Rain runs down a shaft far below the lower level.
The generator coughs twice, then settles into a drone.
A distant bell rings once and never rings again.
Ceiling lights tick on and off in a slow rhythm.
Wet footprints squeak across the tiles toward the stairs.
The cage elevator groans and sways in its shaft.
The floor trembles faintly, like a train passing far off.
A faucet drips in a washroom with no working light.
Wind moans through a crack high in the stone wall.
Something clatters down a metal stairwell, then stops.
A siren wails for a second before the power cuts it.
The smell of burnt wire drifts down from the vent.
Cabinet doors creak open a few inches, then swing shut.
Gears grind behind a wall panel, slow and reluctant.
Two cans knock together on a shelf to the left.
A radio speaker hisses, and a broken voice slips through.
Tile dust crunches under your feet with every step.
Your lockpick set rattles in your pocket as you walk.
The taser hums in your hand and its light blinks red.
The flashlight beam flickers, then steadies over the hallway.
Old pipes tick and groan as the building settles again.
A stairwell door shudders in its frame, far above.
Water runs down the wall in a thin, endless sheet.
A crowbar taps against a steel rail somewhere in the dark.
The save point hums with a pale blue glow.
Thin wires sing in the wind through a torn vent.
Heavy machinery cuts out, and the silence feels worse.
Gravel rolls down a slope in the far tunnel, then stops.
A grate clatters open at the end of the corridor.
Boots echo on a metal catwalk three floors down.
The emergency lamp clicks, then warms with a faint whine.
A stim pack slides off a shelf and rolls under a bench.
Brittle pages crackle every time the air moves.
The signal route lamp blinks twice, then goes dark.
A revive kit clasp snaps shut inside somebody's bag.
Pressure builds in a valve, then releases with a hiss.
A ladder bolt works loose and rattles on its bracket.
The fan bearing grinds slower with every turn.
Ice cracks in the drainage channel under the grate.
Corrugated metal bangs outside in the wind, over and over.
Something taps the pipes once, then again, then nothing.
Dry hinges creak as a door drifts open a crack.
The outage hum dies, and a heavy silence fills the room.
A distant motor whines up, then drops away to nothing.
